description: This file contains a Go implementation of a translator for GCE Persistent Disks, converting between in-tree and CSI representations, handling volume ID formatting, topology translation, and support checks within the Kubernetes CSI plugin framework.

classes.name: gcePersistentDiskCSITranslator
classes.description: A struct implementing translation between in-tree GCE PD and CSI GCE PD for Kubernetes.

methods.name: TranslateInTreeStorageClassToCSI
methods.description: Converts in-tree GCE storage class parameters to CSI storage class, including topology handling.

methods.name: backwardCompatibleAccessModes
methods.description: Adjusts access modes for legacy compatibility, converting ReadWriteMany to ReadWriteOnce.

methods.name: TranslateInTreeInlineVolumeToCSI
methods.description: Converts an inline in-tree GCE Persistent Disk volume to a CSI PersistentVolume.

methods.name: TranslateInTreePVToCSI
methods.description: Converts an in-tree GCE PersistentVolume to a CSI PersistentVolume.

methods.name: TranslateCSIPVToInTree
methods.description: Converts a CSI PersistentVolume back to an in-tree GCE PersistentDisk volume.

methods.name: CanSupport
methods.description: Checks if the plugin supports a given PV with GCEPersistentDisk.

methods.name: CanSupportInline
methods.description: Checks if the plugin supports an inline volume with GCEPersistentDisk.

methods.name: GetInTreePluginName
methods.description: Returns the name of the in-tree plugin driver.

methods.name: GetCSIPluginName
methods.description: Returns the name of the CSI plugin.

methods.name: RepairVolumeHandle
methods.description: Infers project, zone/region from node ID to complete an unspecified volume handle.
